_meta.purpose: Template for logging each EXP7 replication trial. Copy this structure once per run, fill in, append to exp7_run_log.json. Do not alter field names across runs - comparability depends on identical structure.
_meta.instructions: Fill ground_truth_event and ground_truth_detail BEFORE reading either arm's trace output (see protocol Section 5, blinding). Scoring values must be exactly one of: correct | partial | confabulated | not_mentioned.

clip_structure_notes: brief description of baseline/hold/event phases and their approx timestamps
ground_truth_event: ONE sentence, written before scoring, describing what actually happened
ground_truth_detail: ONE sentence, written before scoring, describing the checkable planted detail (text/brand/color/count) and its correct value

sequential_arm.delivery_method: stateless frames one at a time / single growing session one at a time
sequential_arm.confidence_at_violation_point: if applicable, the model's stated confidence just before the event, for comparison to run 1's 96%

spacetime_arm.delivery_method: full video at once / all stills at once
